name: Instatic Self-Hosted CMS
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted visual CMS and site builder with content collections, forms, SQLite/Postgres support, plugins and static-page publishing; no software license quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Requires a self-managed Bun/Docker host, database, backups and HTTPS. Optional AI agents require your own model/API access and may incur usage charges; Railway/Render deployments may cost money. Upstream is pre-1.0 (0.0.x) and APIs can change.
